name: Sea Cliff Bridge & Grand Pacific Walk
blurb: Walk the 665 m bridge that curves out over the ocean below the cliffs.
weatherNote: No shade on the bridge or the roadside path: go early on hot days. Skip it in rain, when there's little to see and nowhere to shelter.
gettingThere: South Coast Line train from Central to Coalcliff (≈ 1 hr 10). Only every second train stops there on weekends, so check the time. Walk over the bridge to Scarborough station for the train back.
newcomerTip: Want a longer walk? Get off at Stanwell Park instead and follow the Grand Pacific Walk shared path (≈ 3.5 km) to Coalcliff, then cross the bridge.

facts.v: Easy, steep hill at the start

legs.title: South Coast Line to Coalcliff
legs.detail: Direct every 2 hrs on weekends (e.g. 8:29, 10:29, 12:29). Other trains: change at Thirroul (≈ 1 hr 40)

back.text: It's one way. From Scarborough station, a direct train to Central runs about every 2 hours on weekends (≈ 1 hr 15). In between, ride south to Thirroul and change for Central (≈ 1 hr 30).

notes: Roadside parking near both ends of the bridge. Our tip: it fills fast on sunny weekends.
It's a one-way walk: walk back over the bridge, or take the train one stop from Scarborough to Coalcliff.

routes.ride: Not practical from the city: it's a long, expensive ride. Take the train.

visit.bestTime: Any dry day. The bridge is a good spot to watch for whales during the migration season.
visit.hours: Always open. On weekends trains stop at Coalcliff and Scarborough about every 2 hours each way: note the times before you set off.
facilities: Ocean rock pool at Coalcliff Beach, below the start
Boardwalk and viewing platform at Clifton, just south of the bridge
Scarborough Hotel, a pub near the finish
visit.access: Wollongong Council has built full-width shared paths, boardwalks and ramps along this stretch, and Destination Wollongong says the bridge welcomes people with access needs. The walk down from Coalcliff station is steep.
safety: Stay on the footpath: it runs beside a busy road
The path is shared with bikes at Clifton and Coalcliff: keep left
